definitions.gloss: side view — a technical drawing or illustration showing an object or building viewed from the side
definitions.explanation: A drawing that shows an object, vehicle, or building as seen from the side. One of the standard views used in technical drawing, architectural drafting, and product design, alongside {正面図|しょうめんず} ('front view') and {平面図|へいめんず} ('plan/top view').

examples.japanese: ⟦{機械|きかい}→機械：02366_kikai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{側面図|そくめんず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: To draw a side view of the machine.

examples.japanese: {側面図|そくめんず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}れば→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦{高|たか}さ→高さ：05327_takasa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{分|わ}かる→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: You can clearly see the height by looking at the side view.

examples.japanese: ⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{側面図|そくめんず}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{位置|いち}→位置：11554_ichi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{示|しめ}されている→示す：01948_shimesu⟧。
examples.english: The position of the windows is shown on the side view of the building.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{図面|ずめん}→図面：12023_zumen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{正面図|しょうめんず}、{側面図|そくめんず}、⟦{平面図|へいめんず}→平面図：23670_heimenzu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{三|みっ}つ→三つ：02970_mittsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{含|ふく}まれている→含む：01982_fukumu⟧。
examples.english: This drawing set includes three views: front, side, and top.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{側面|そくめん}→側面：05779_sokumen⟧ ('side, side face') and ⟦{図|ず}→図：03368_zu⟧ ('drawing, diagram').

USAGE:
- A standard technical-drawing term used in architecture, mechanical engineering, and product design.
- Normally appears as part of a set of orthographic projections: {正面図|しょうめんず} (front view), {側面図|そくめんず} (side view), and ⟦{平面図|へいめんず}→平面図：23670_heimenzu⟧ (plan/top view).
- Sometimes further specified as {右|みぎ}{側面図|そくめんず} ('right side view') or {左|ひだり}{側面図|そくめんず} ('left side view') when the two sides differ.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {側面図|そくめんず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|えが}く→描く：02013_egaku⟧/⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧: to draw a side view
- {側面図|そくめんず}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{示|しめ}す→示す：01948_shimesu⟧: to show in a side view
- {右|みぎ}{側面図|そくめんず}: right side view
- ⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{側面図|そくめんず}: a building's side elevation

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {正面図|しょうめんず}: front view — the view from directly in front of the object.
- ⟦{平面図|へいめんず}→平面図：23670_heimenzu⟧: plan view, top view — the view from directly above.
- ⟦{断面図|だんめんず}→断面図：14837_danmenzu⟧: cross-section, sectional drawing — shows the interior along a cut plane.
- ⟦{立面図|りつめんず}→立面図：23671_ritsumenzu⟧: elevation drawing — a general architectural term; side views are a kind of ⟦{立面図|りつめんず}→立面図：23671_ritsumenzu⟧.
- ⟦{側面|そくめん}→側面：05779_sokumen⟧: side, side face (as a noun) — the base word, referring to the physical side surface rather than the drawing.
